title: Marine squadron commander saw the churning white water

tellings.quote: believe, a squadron commander from a a Marine Corps squadron that was actually flying by U. Kurt, I think, is his name.

plain: In 2004, off the coast of Southern California, a commander of a Marine Corps squadron who happened to be flying by also saw the churning white water on the ocean surface, the same disturbance that Navy pilots linked to the Tic Tac, a white oval object shaped like the mint. The writer Marik von Rennenkampff brings this up, naming the commander, a little unsure, as Kurth. It matters because it would add another trained witness to the Navy pilots' story.
